description: Shell script to install host system binaries with required libraries, including functions for copying, moving, creating directories, symbolic links, relative paths, and patching binaries.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates symbolic links with verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Calculates relative path between two directories.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Generates a shared library to modify process argument zero.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be patched based on its type.
